messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — elevated 5xx & gateway timeouts in region us-west-2 on service gateway-proxy (alert: 5xx_rate > 4.5% over 5m)

alice (oncall): I'm oncall, taking ownership. grabbing dashboards now — link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/gateway-usw2

alice (oncall): initial check: higher 504/502 counts from model-service upstream in us-west-2, latency spike around 12:10 UTC. Will post logs.

ben (runtime): thx. can you paste a few example upstream errors? also which model-variant is most affected?

cassie (ingress): seeing connection pool exhaustion to model-service-usw2 cluster. samples from ingress logs:

```
2026-03-14T12:11:05Z ingress-1 gateway-proxy pid=3245 msg="upstream error" code=504 target=model-svc-usw2-03 conn_wait=120.3ms pool_active=128/128
2026-03-14T12:11:07Z ingress-3 gateway-proxy pid=3291 msg="upstream error" code=502 target=model-svc-usw2-02 backend_err="connection reset"
```

cassie (ingress): pool_active hitting pool_max (128). downstream queuing increases latencies -> 504s.

dan (netops): any network flaps in us-west-2? BGP/ecmp looks fine. No infra saturations on egress. CPU on model nodes moderate. This looks like too many concurrent HTTP connections on model svc.

ben (runtime): sounds like KV cache cold/missing items are causing a thundering herd to model-frontend. Any recent rollout to model-service?

alice (oncall): no deployments in the last hour per deploy-log. I see config change 3h ago for keepalive tuning but shouldn't affect pools immediately.

kirill (observability): heatmap -> request concurrency per instance spiked from 20->240 in 2m. Correlating with increased cache-miss rate on prefix cache: 92% miss for the high-traffic prefix set.

elena (support): customers reporting degraded responses in west. initial CS count: 7 high-severity customer alerts. Tracking in INCIDENT-2135.

ben (runtime): mitigation options: 1) increase connection pool size on gateway-proxy nodes 2) enable traffic-steer to route a portion to us-east-1 3) scale up model-service-usw2 horizontally 4) enable short-term circuit breaker to shed load.

alice (oncall): prioritize minimal blast radius. I'm going to steer 30% of production traffic from us-west-2 -> us-east-1 and increase gateway pool by +32 concurrently. posting runbook steps.

alice (oncall): invoking routing-change via infra-cli:

```
infra-cli traffic steer \
  --from-region us-west-2 \
  --to-region us-east-1 \
  --percent 30 \
  --policy gradual 60s
```
deploy-bot: executed by alice. change-id=chg-9421. Applying gradual steer (30%) over 60s.

deploy-bot: status=applied progress=100% new-route-weight: us-west-2=70 us-east-1=30

alice (oncall): increasing gateway pool size via config push to gateway-proxy-usw2:

```
cfgctl set gateway-proxy.pool.max 160 --env production --region us-west-2
cfgctl rollout gateway-proxy --wait
```
deploy-bot: config change chg-9422 applied, rollout complete.

cassie (ingress): pool max increased to 160 across proxies, pool_active now peaking ~150 but no longer saturating. upstream 504s drop ~50% in first 2m.

kirill (observability): metrics update: 5xx rate down from 6.3% -> 2.9% in 4m. p50 latency improved, p95 remains elevated.

ben (runtime): I'll scale up model-service-usw2 by +3 nodes (manual), and enable short circuit breaker on high-cost routes to avoid retries amplifying load.

ben (runtime): scale command:
```
kubectl -n models scale deploy/model-service-usw2 --replicas=12
```
deploy-bot: scale job accepted, pods starting (3 new pods).

alice (oncall): support — can you start incident customer comms? note that partial mitigation in place, some customers may still see degraded performance, we're steering traffic and scaling.

elena (support): on it. drafting post to status page and sending targeted emails to impacted customers listed in INCIDENT-2135.

frank (sre-next): I'll take a watch and pick up postmortem tomorrow. if things look stable in 30m, we can transition to monitoring mode.

alice (oncall): current action summary: 1) traffic-steer 30% to us-east-1 (done) 2) pool max increased to 160 (done) 3) model-service scale +3 (in progress) 4) circuit-breaker applied on heavy routes (done) 5) support notified.

kirill (observability): log sample after mitigation shows fewer conn_wait timeouts and fewer "connection reset" upstream errors.

alice (oncall): marking incident state: mitigating -> partial. still monitoring for residual errors, will keep thread updated.

incident-bot: incident status: PARTIAL_MITIGATION. severity=P2. paging paused for new pages in this incident.

alice (oncall): handoff note for next oncall (frank): please review scaling and whether to revert traffic-steer after scale stabilizes. Check KV cache warmup — we should consider pre-warming prefixes.

frank (sre-next): ack, I'll take over in 30m if stable. will prepare postmortem skeleton and list follow-ups (cache tuning, pool sizing, runbook gaps).

alice (oncall): thanks team. final note: no configuration rollbacks performed. root cause suspected cascade from cache misses -> model-frontend concurrency -> connection pool exhaustion. we'll triage deeper in postmortem. :thumbsup:

elena (support): status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2135 — message: "Degraded responses in US-West; partial mitigation in place, majority of traffic restored."

incident-bot: incident timeline updated. assign postmortem owner=frank.

alice (oncall): closing live mitigation. continuing observation for 45m then move to postmortem.
